title: Initial configuration encoding
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, define its initial configuration encoding as a pair encoding of the binary expansion of the number represented by the decoded first component of $z$ and a second pair encoding. The second encoding consists of the rowwise modular transformation of the pair encoding of that binary expansion with the decoded second component of $z$, paired with an encoding of the singleton list containing true and the pair encoding of the count of the decoded second component of $z$ with the empty list.
caveat: The pair encoding, decoders, rowwise transformation, and count operation are not defined in the supplied snippet.
